http_port.label: HTTP Server Port
http_port.description: Port for the MSX HTTP server.

output_format.label: Audio Output Format
output_format.description: Audio format for streaming to MSX (mp3, aac, or flac).

player_idle_timeout.label: Player Idle Timeout (minutes)
player_idle_timeout.description: Unregister MSX players after this many minutes without activity.

show_stop_notification.label: Show notification before closing player
show_stop_notification.description: Show confirmation dialog on MSX when stopping playback from MA.

enable_player_grouping.label: Enable player grouping (experimental)
enable_player_grouping.description: Experimental: allow grouping multiple MSX TVs to play the same track simultaneously. Disable if you experience issues with multi-TV setups.

enable_sendspin_bridge.label: Sendspin bridge (experimental)
enable_sendspin_bridge.description: Register each TV as a Sendspin client so it can join sample-synchronized playback groups with any Music Assistant players. When a synchronized stream starts, the TV automatically opens the web kiosk in Sendspin mode. Requires a TV browser capable of running the Sendspin web client; playback falls back to the regular HTTP player when the TV cannot connect.

group_stream_mode.label: Stream Delivery Mode
group_stream_mode.description: How audio reaches the TVs. 'Independent' proxies a separate stream per TV (more CPU, no sync). 'Shared Buffer' uses one ffmpeg process for all group members (less CPU). 'MA Streamserver' redirects TVs to the Music Assistant streamserver directly — least CPU, per-player codec and DSP applied by MA; falls back to Independent when the URL cannot be resolved. Note: in MA Streamserver mode grouped TVs each fetch their own stream (no shared-buffer sync).

options.independent: Independent (default) - each TV has own proxied stream
options.shared: Shared Buffer - one ffmpeg, multiple readers (less CPU)
options.redirect: MA Streamserver - redirect TVs to Music Assistant directly

manifest.description: Stream music to Smart TVs via Media Station X
